mapper.select: SELECT crm14_share_default_id AS share_id , crm14_share_cd AS share_code , crm14_share_nm AS share_name , crm14_person_id AS person_id , crm14_person_nm AS person_name , crm14_org_id AS org_id , crm14_org_nm AS org_name FROM ( SELECT crm14_share_default.* , f_cdnm('ShareCode', crm14_share_cd, crm14_company_id, f_today()) AS crm14_share_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(crm14_person_id) AS crm14_person_nm , f_org_nm(crm14_org_id, f_today()) AS crm14_org_nm FROM crm14_share_default WHERE crm14_contact_id = #{contactId} AND crm14_company_id = #{companyId} ) t ORDER BY crm14_share_cd DESC , crm14_org_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , crm14_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm14_share_default ( crm14_share_default_id, crm14_contact_id, crm14_share_cd, crm14_person_id, crm14_org_id, crm14_company_id ) VALUES ( #{shareId}, #{contactId}, #{shareCode}, #{personId}, #{orgId}, #{companyId} )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN crm14_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(crm14_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(crm14_org_id, f_today()) END FROM crm14_share_default WHERE crm14_contact_id = #{contactId} ORDER BY crm14_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| COUNT(*)-1 END) FROM crm14_share_default WHERE crm14_contact_id = #{contactId}
SELECT count(*) FROM crm09_contact WHERE crm09_contact_id = #{contactId} AND crm09_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT crm15_share_id AS share_id , crm15_share_cd AS share_code , crm15_share_nm AS share_name , crm15_person_id AS person_id , crm15_person_nm AS person_name , crm15_org_id AS org_id , crm15_org_nm AS org_name FROM ( SELECT crm15_share.* , f_cdnm('ShareCode', crm15_share_cd, crm15_company_id, COALESCE(crm12_reg_date, f_today())) AS crm15_share_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(crm15_person_id) AS crm15_person_nm , f_org_nm(crm15_org_id, COALESCE(crm12_reg_date, f_today())) AS crm15_org_nm FROM crm15_share LEFT OUTER JOIN crm12_work_detail ON crm12_work_detail_id = crm15_work_detail_id WHERE crm15_work_detail_id = #{workDetailId} AND crm15_company_id = #{companyId} ) t ORDER BY crm15_share_cd DESC , crm15_org_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , crm15_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
